notes.title: Small update - bigger update coming early 2020!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we just pushed a new update to Jelly Bomber. If you have difficulty getting the game to run, please right click and do "Verify game files" under properties, and it should work just fine.

This version has a bunch of small improvements, most notably, making it more clear to new players that RANKED PLAY is available. It is now available at the start on a fresh install, whereas before, you had to play a match of Free Play with all three characters.

We have a big update coming in the next month or two, so stay tuned!
